title: RuntimeExecutionClaimRequest
description: HTTP/runtime request body for POST /v1/sessions/<session-id>/actions/<action-id>/claims. The path supplies session_id and action_id; the body carries compare-and-set fields only.

lease_id.description: Optional caller-selected lease id. When omitted, the daemon derives lease-<expected_decision_id>.

initial_lease_ms.description: Optional shorter initial lease duration. The daemon still enforces its upper bound and action budget.
